title: Authority policy is version-bound, additive, deterministic, and fail-closed
statement: Every governed resource MUST resolve against a trusted materialized policy bound to package, Constitution, immutable source, additive extensions, and resolved digests; protected narrow rules MUST outrank broad rules, including Inspector tests inside package source and Auditor output inside Architect working papers, the glossary MUST resolve as one joint Owner-Architect authority set, and unknown or conflicting highest-precedence matches MUST deny before dispatch.
rationale: A broad first-match rule or stale materialized policy can silently invert Article 6. Explicit precedence and digest provenance make the mapping deterministic and auditable.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
